evaluationEvidence.reuse: StochBench provides a domain-specific benchmark for formal theorem proving, enabling evaluation of different LLM-based provers on stochastic processes problems.
evaluationEvidence.scoring: The benchmark reports proof rate, with an Opus 4.8-based agent achieving 34.9% proof rate under a 15-minute per-problem limit.
evaluationEvidence.task: StochBench is a Lean 4 benchmark of 450 graduate stochastic-processes problems covering finite and countable Markov chains, renewal processes, random walks, martingales, stopping times, queues, Brownian motion, stochastic calculus, weak convergence, and Poisson and continuous-time Markov processes.
